text: Eight p.m. The shelf is empty... and your sales report calls it a quiet hour.
ShelfSense watches every shelf, in every dark store, hour by hour, and tells you which ones won't make it to tomorrow's truck.
Pick one, and watch it coming. The forecast, and what really happened... almost on top of each other.
Every call is checked against what happened next. So you know exactly when to trust it.
All inside Exasol. Seconds to think... milliseconds to replay.
ShelfSense. Catch the empty shelf... before your customer does.
